title: File:Route from Bangkok to Chiang Saen Map 1881 by Carl Bock.png
author: Carl Bock (1849-1932), Edward Weller (cartographer) (1819–1884)
description: The Norwegian explorer Carl Bock travelled through Thailand in 1881 with the support of King Chulalongkorn (Rama V). This map shows his route from Bangkok to Chiang Saen (Kiang-Tsen). From the book Temples and elephants: The narrative of a journey of exploration through upper Siam and Lao. Published in 1884. Digitization: Staatsbibliothek zu Berlin – Preußischer Kulturbesitz, Germany.
